utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I can help with that drive, Dane. Tell me what still needs fixing and I’ll keep track.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I’m running a bit late, but I’ve got the drive here. The main thing still needing fixing is the power connector.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Got it, I’ll keep track of the power connector and stay ready to help when you’re set.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sure, I can help with that. What exactly needs fixing on the drive?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: It’s the repair drive itself that needs checking. I’d like to make sure the issue is only the drive and not the cable or port first.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Got it, I’ll check the drive first and then test the cable and port if needed.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’ve got a few spare tarps and a hammer if the repair drive still needs them.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right, good to know. I think we could use both of those.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Great, I’ll set those aside for the drive.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can help with that. What do you need from the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I need a few specific parts, and I’m trying not to miss anything from the list.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Tell me the list, and I’ll help you check it line by line.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: How much do you still need for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I heard it’s still a bit short, but I don’t have the exact number yet.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Got it - can you check and let me know the exact amount?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, I heard the repair drive is picking up steam again, and folks are dropping off tools this afternoon. Gus, you should swing by if you need anything fixed.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Yeah, I heard they’re setting up at the hall around two, so I’d head over then if you need a hand.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: I’m putting up the flyer for the repair drive now, and I’ll pass the word to a few more neighbors too.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Quinn. I’ll keep an eye on who needs a hand and note the ones who show up.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Great, thanks. I’ll keep spreading the word and send anyone I hear about your way.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Happy to help with the repair drive, Kira. Tell me what still needs doing and I’ll pitch in.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Can you confirm what’s still left on the repair drive? I want to make sure I’m looking at the right list.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I’m checking the list now and I’ll confirm exactly what’s still open for you.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely, Bo. I’ll keep the repair drive organized and make sure everyone knows where to help.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Great, I’ll help keep it moving.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yeah, I can help with that repair drive. Just tell me where you need me.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Great, thanks. I’d like you to start at my front gate at nine, then work your way down the driveway.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Sounds good, I’ll start at your front gate at nine and work down the driveway.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right, the repair drive. I might need a nudge on the details, but I’m in.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Yeah, remind me what the first thing needs doing, and I’ll get on it.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Hey Ira, I can help line people up for the repair drive. Who still needs a task?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I can check around for anyone who still needs a role, and maybe ask at the corner store too.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: That helps a lot. I’ll start asking around here too so we can fill the remaining slots fast.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely, I can spread the word about the repair drive and get people moving on it.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I’m in, Quinn. I can help once I catch up with everyone.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Perfect, I’ll start spreading the word right away.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I heard about the repair drive. What do you need me to do?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I need you to track down the parts and handle the deliveries on Saturday morning. I’ll keep the list simple and leave it on my porch.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can do that. I’ll pick up the parts and get the deliveries to you Saturday morning.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can swing by after school drop-off and before pickup, if that helps. Just tell me what needs fixing.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: That would help a lot. I’ll walk you through the fixes when you arrive, and we can start with whatever’s most urgent.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Perfect, I’ll head over after drop-off and before pickup. We can start with the urgent stuff first.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I can help spread the word about the repair drive if you want.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Sure, I can do that. I’ll spread the word and mention the repair drive to a few people.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely — I’ll mention the repair drive too.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Yeah, I can lend a hand. Tell me what needs fixing, and I’ll bring the right tools.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’d rather keep it simple so we don’t get stuck waiting on parts. What tools should I set aside for you?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Just set aside a hammer, a screwdriver, and a tape measure. If you’ve got a level and a utility knife handy, those wouldn’t hurt either.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I can check the address and make sure the repair drive gets there.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Great, thank you. I’ll note that the drive can get there.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Perfect, I’ll keep track of the address and make sure the repair drive gets there.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: I can help with that, but I need to know what’s being fixed and when you want me to come by.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Sure—what exactly needs fixing, and what time should I come by?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I can help with that. Tell me what still needs fixing and I’ll lend a hand.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I still need a few odds and ends, but I can walk you through the list. The big stuff is the leaky sink and the back gate.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Tell me the rest of the list, and I’ll help you tackle the sink and the gate.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I heard there was a repair drive, but I only got the update secondhand. Is it still going on?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: I think it’s still going on, though I might’ve missed the latest update. I’d check with whoever’s organizing it to be sure.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Got it, I’ll check with the organizer to confirm.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: So the repair drive is definitely happening today, right?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Yeah, it’s happening today. I heard they’re starting pretty soon, so if you need anything checked, now’s the time.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Right, it’s definitely today? I just want to be sure before I head out.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I heard the repair drive is moving along; I can swing by after errands and see what still needs doing.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Ira. I’d appreciate that.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Absolutely. I’ll stop by after I finish my errands and check what still needs doing.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right, the repair drive. I meant to bring it up with you, Leo, but I forgot the details. Could you remind me what we were fixing?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Right, we were fixing the porch step and that loose hinge on the gate.
